definitions.gloss: to walk side by side; to stand alongside
definitions.explanation: Literally, to line up one's shoulders with someone — to walk or stand next to each other.

definitions.gloss: to rival; to be on par with; to equal
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to be at the same level as someone in skill, status, or achievement. Often used to describe reaching the level of a superior competitor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肩|かた}を{並|なら}べて⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: The two walked side by side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{肩|かた}を{並|なら}べて⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}めた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: I watched the sunset standing alongside my friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ついに⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦トップ→トップ：03862_toppu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{肩|かた}を{並|なら}べた。
examples.english: He finally rivaled the best in the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{肩|かた}を{並|なら}べるほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{技術力|ぎじゅつりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: This company has the technological capability to rival major corporations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧や⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{肩|かた}を{並|なら}べる⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧になった。
examples.english: Japanese wine has now reached the point where it can stand alongside famous wines from overseas.

notes:
USAGE:
The literal meaning (sense 1) is straightforward. The figurative meaning (sense 2) is more commonly encountered and implies reaching an equal level after effort or growth. Often used with ～ほど or ～⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ to emphasize the degree of achievement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{肩|かた}を{並|なら}べる (to rival the world's best)
- {肩|かた}を{並|なら}べて⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk side by side)
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{肩|かた}を{並|なら}べるほど (to the extent of rivaling ~)
